## Bounded security verification request — DO NOT APPLY HOSTED MIGRATIONS

**Backlog:** [#71](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/71), checklist items #04–#06 (and preparatory aspects of #07). Related existing owner task [#67](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/issues/67); [draft PR #68](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/68), head at initial inventory `cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551`. Re-verify live head and main before starting.

**Status: PREPARED / NOT_STARTED.** This issue is a request for **Codex primary implementer** to produce isolated disposable PostgreSQL17 evidence and a clean integration proposal. ChatGPT independently reviews exact-head source and observed tests; owner exclusively decides whether to accept any third SQL migration, merge, or authorize hosted use. The owner has **NOT approved** migration `supabase/migrations/20261015171325_restrict_book_privileges.sql` for remote application.

### Evidence problem

- The first two accepted source SQL migrations are `20261009000000_initial_author_books.sql` and `20261009010000_restrict_accepted_manuscript_dml.sql`.
- PR68 contains the **proposed, unapproved** `20261015171325_restrict_book_privileges.sql` and `tests/book_privileges_regression.sql` targeting the effective `books` TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER grants and cross-author behavior; earlier reports indicate PostgreSQL17 fixture **NOT_RUN**, so proof is missing.
- PR68 also edits older `implementation-foundation.yml` triggers that may restore overlapping automatic CI after PR70 merged; full PR68 rebase/CI reconciliation is separately required.
- PR65 contains earlier ChatGPT-authored content partly carried into PR68 by provenance-bearing cherry-picks. Do not blindly merge or silently claim Codex authored earlier commits.

### Permission envelope

1. Read accepted owner scope, PR68, original two migrations, proposed third migration and privilege fixture, current merged `main`/CI and relevant task/pack/bundle evidence. Do not claim Phase-B owner authorization from a Phase-A-only pack; if changing scope, commit a new owner-approved amendment or task and generate immutable pinned pack before edits.
2. In an isolated Codex branch/worktree, **run** the existing regression using a fresh disposable **PostgreSQL 17** instance with no linked Supabase project, authenticating only local disposable test roles. Capture actual command, version, log, exit code, original defect reproduction and corrected-state matrix. Ensure fixture cleanup and no real author data. On unavailable Docker/PG17, report BLOCKED with exact reason, never PASS.
3. Verify that with only migrations 1–2 the grant regression fails as expected and that with the **proposed** third migration and proper RLS fixtures it passes, including explicit TRUNCATE, unauthorized grants and cross-author INSERT/SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE negative cases.
4. Review possibility of SQL privilege side effects for API operations, PostgREST, future migrations and DDL; a passing synthetic PG17 regression does not itself establish hosted compatibility.
5. Record proof + defects in a new Task, ContextPack, ExecutionBundle and draft correction PR or evidence-only reviewed comment as appropriate. Do **not** mutate PR68 branch without Codex task authorization; preserve original PR authorship. Any merged-main CI trigger conflict must be identified, not reintroduced.
6. Return a clear owner decision packet: SQL diff and rationale; PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED status; whether the exact proposed third migration is ready for **separate explicit owner approval**, and what hosted checks remain.

### Forbidden / separate owner gates

- **No** hosted Supabase `db push`, `db reset`, migration apply, production/dev data modification, service-role keys, auth refresh or API secrets.
- **No** merger of PR65/68 or cherry-pick of migration into main without owner approval.
- **No** payment/billing changes, live users/manuscripts, deployments or security-hold waiver.
- The signed-out unexpired-JWT direct PostgREST risk remains unresolved separately (#09); do not claim real private-pilot readiness.
- This GitHub issue does not dispatch a Codex runtime or authorize the migration merely because the owner broadly asked to solve the remaining checklist.

### Acceptance

PG17 exact version and source SHA recorded; original default privilege defect objectively reproduced; proposed regression passed or failure honestly reported; negative tests cover privileges/RLS/cross-author; independent ChatGPT review complete; owner migration disposition recorded separately; no hosted writes.

## 2026-10-17 coordinator handoff — next bounded Codex evidence task (no hosted SQL approval)

**Dependency now verified:** Owner merged [PR #76](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/76), `main = 021379856d07611752832b44bfe951d6ae36f0b2`; [post-merge CI #39075424325](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/39075424325) SUCCESS. Effective main now **includes** PR-to-task compliance checks. Re-fetch actual main before doing anything; use latest actual SHA rather than a hardcoded stale parent. Existing proposed [PR #68](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/68) currently heads at `cbb379fa4a4eaa9f576f3abcce2c2258d22cc551`; its third SQL migration remains **NOT OWNER APPROVED**.

### Codex bounded start for Issue74

- Codex is primary implementer/executor, ChatGPT independent coordinator/reviewer, owner retains migration/merge/hosted authority. This comment is **a reviewable handoff**; it has NOT launched a Codex runtime or conferred hosted approval. User has requested continuation of the remediation work in the coordinating conversation, with this queued local-only evidence task already identified.
- Obtain an unused unique Task ID *from the current repo*, snapshot this issue and source refs, and commit a new valid immutable pinned ContextPack before any new implementation edits; use an isolated branch/worktree from the current `main`. Authorize only **disposable local PostgreSQL 17** testing, synthetic fixtures, bounded evidence recording and one reviewable report. If only running an evidence experiment without changing source, retain exact commands/logs on Issue74 or a bounded evidence-only proposal; do not pretend that a PR68 Phase-A-only ContextPack authorizes subsequent code.
- **Read-only source under test:** copy the exact unmerged PR68 artifacts into **throwaway test storage**, not `main`: `supabase/migrations/20261009000000_initial_author_books.sql`, `supabase/migrations/20261009010000_restrict_accepted_manuscript_dml.sql`, proposed `supabase/migrations/20261015171325_restrict_book_privileges.sql`, and `tests/book_privileges_regression.sql`. Identify precise SHA/blob IDs from the source checkout, PostgreSQL `server_version`, startup and teardown actions. No edits/pushes to PR68 or migration tree without separate scope/owner decision.
- In a clean disposable **PG17**, prove that original 1–2 migration privilege state does **not** satisfy the expected negative grant matrix (expected failure is **evidence of defect**, not all tests PASS). Then apply the **proposed** third migration in a fresh disposable environment and prove corrected **TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER, RLS owner/cross-author SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE**, with explicit expected-vs-observed and exit logs. Never confuse an expected before-fix failure with a post-fix PASS; inspect SQL fixtures carefully for how they emulate default privileges and use synthetic roles.
- Verify whether the proposed grant correction also affects permitted PostgREST/Nest operations (especially the current transport), note compatibility assumptions, and explicitly distinguish PG17 synthetic evidence from real hosted Supabase acceptance. If disposable PG17/Docker isn't available, report **BLOCKED/NOT_RUN** with exact failure, never assert a success.
- **Current compliance caveat:** do not add an unapproved `.sql` or changed migration to an implementation PR and assume current base-anchored CI allows it; security-sensitive SQL files require a distinct reviewed-base owner migration-path-approval record. A purely read-only experiment does not constitute migration approval. If more scope is needed, pause and request a new owner-authorized task/immutable ContextPack.
- Deliver a concise FACT/INTERPRETATION/PROPOSAL report, Task/CP/EB identifiers and immutable source hashes (when used), before/after raw output, tested PostgreSQL exact version, command exit codes, test and cleanup evidence, and explicit migration-owner decision packet. Provide draft PR **only if** the bounded implementation/evidence changes genuinely need repo integration and can pass current governed CI; otherwise a read-only Issue74 evidence comment is acceptable. No merge or hosted operations.

**No** `supabase db push`, `db reset`, hosted dev/prod access, migration apply on real project, service tokens, private manuscripts, billing/settings/deployments, PR65/68 merge or third-migration approval. Actual signed-out JWT direct-PostgREST risk remains a separate blocker to private-manuscript piloting.

**Current state of this issue:** READY FOR EXTERNAL CODEX EXECUTION / NOT_STARTED IN THIS COORDINATOR CHAT. Do not mislabel a GitHub issue comment as tool-executed Codex work.
